messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — first day! I'm blocked on onboarding. When I try to open Gmail it goes to an access denied page. Okta didn't prompt me to enroll MFA and my 1Password invite still shows 'pending'. Cleared cookies and tried incognito. Who should I ping to get my accounts provisioned? Thanks!
IT Support: Welcome, Maya :tada: Can you try signing into https://redwood.okta.com with your company email first? Sometimes the activation email is separate from the 1Password invite.
Maya Chen: I tried that link — it lands on a page that says "Account not assigned". No activation email in my inbox (checked spam).
IT Support: OK that looks like a license/assignment issue. @Samir (Identity) — can you check if Maya's Google license and Okta assignment went through?
Samir (Identity): On it. Maya, can you DM me your full name and the email you used to sign up (just to confirm)?
Maya Chen: DM sent with maya.chen@example.com
Samir (Identity): Thanks — I see your Okta user but it wasn't assigned the Google Workspace app during provisioning (we had a hiccup with the batch job this morning). I'm reassigning now and re-sending the Okta activation email and the 1Password invitation. Give it ~2 mins and try the Okta link again.
IT Support: If Okta still doesn't prompt for MFA after activation, try this flow: 1) sign into https://redwood.okta.com 2) click "Set up MFA" when prompted or go to Settings > Extra Verification 3) choose Authenticator app or Push 4) if you use a hardware key, choose WebAuthn.
Samir (Identity): Done — reassignments pushed. Also flagged your account for a forced activation email.
Okta Bot: Activation email sent to maya.chen@example.com.
Maya Chen: Got the activation email and followed the link. It asked me to enroll MFA, and I accepted push notifications to the Okta Verify app. However when I try Gmail I still get redirected to the access denied page.
IT Support: Two quick checks: a) Log out of any personal Google accounts in the browser or use a fresh incognito window. b) Ensure you're signing into workspace at mail.google.com using your company email (not personal). We sometimes see SSO token caching issues.
Maya Chen: Tried incognito and opened mail.google.com, clicked sign in, used company creds, then Okta push — still access denied page after login. Says "Your account does not have access to this service."
Samir (Identity): That message means the Google Workspace license wasn't fully attached to the user object. I re-ran the license sync job and manually granted a Workspace license to Maya. Can you try again in 1 minute?
1Password Bot: Invitation resent to maya.chen@example.com.
Maya Chen: Re-tried and now Gmail loads! Okta MFA enrolled as well. 1Password invite arrived separately — it's opening now.
IT Support: Nice. Quick note for 1Password: when you accept the invite you'll be prompted to create your account and set a master password, then optionally enable a second factor (we recommend WebAuthn or an authenticator app). If you want, enable device pin as an extra safety measure.
Maya Chen: 1Password set up and I enabled WebAuthn with my YubiKey. Everything seems to be working. Huge thanks @Samir (Identity) and IT Support :pray: :partyparrot:
Samir (Identity): Welcome aboard, Maya! If anything else pops up with SSO or access, ping #eng or DM me.
IT Support: Adding a quick troubleshooting snippet we use for future new-hires (copy/paste):
```
1) Confirm Okta activation email received and account activated
2) Enroll in Okta MFA (Okta Verify or WebAuthn)
3) Clear browser cookies or use incognito if SSO redirects weirdly
4) Ensure Google Workspace license is assigned in admin console
5) If still blocked, escalate to identity team with user email and screenshot
```
Maya Chen: Saved — thanks again!
IT Support: Welcome to Redwood :rocket:
